results.bound: \widetilde{O}((n+m)d^{\kappa} + d^{\tau}\sqrt{nmw}) \text{ where } \kappa = O(\tau^{-2}) \text{ and } d^{\kappa} \le min\{n,m\}
results.quote: Given integer matrices $X\in\mathbb{Z}^{n\times d}$ and $Y\in\mathbb{Z}^{d\times m}$, with entries of polynomial magnitude in $n+m$, and $w\ge 1$ distinct specified positions in $XY$, those entries can be computed deterministically in time $\widetilde{O}((n+m)d^\kappa+d^\tau\sqrt{nmw})$.

There are absolute constants $\delta_1,\delta_2>0$ such that integer 3SUM on n polynomially bounded integers has a deterministic $O(n^{2-\delta_1})$-time algorithm, and APSP on an n-vertex directed graph with polynomially bounded integer edge weights and no negative cycle has a deterministic $O(n^{3-\delta_2})$-time algorithm.
